authority: UI-facing 3D MT top surface layer reads the observed full-density MT top-envelope artifact in top_envelope_surface manifest/stats/provenance and wired through projects/utah-forge/project.json.

inputs.notes: Observed top-envelope surface reads the source-derived full-density tile set and keeps the top-most observed MT cell-center point per unique XY column.

producedBy.notes: Script derives the observed top envelope from processed full-density tile binaries and does not read raw archived source bytes.

crs.scene: scene-local meters, X east, Y north, Z up, origin easting 341467.35, northing 4273374.5, elevation 0
crs.notes: Provenance records source CRS and scene-local transform. Acceptance still requires spatial/visual review.

units.notes: Visible colors encode top-point elevation; resistivity values remain per-vertex scalar metadata.

scalar.transform: top-envelope log10 resistivity preserved as per-vertex scalar metadata
scalar.notes: Visible top-surface colors encode observed top-point elevation; scalar metadata keeps top-contact resistivity available for later style work.

processing.method: Observed top-envelope surface from the full-density MT cell-center tile set. The top-most source point is retained per unique XY column and triangulated directly in observed scene coordinates.
processing.downsampling: No preview downsampling for the visible surface; one top-most observed point is retained per unique XY column.
processing.masking: No rectangular support grid or exterior fill. Delaunay triangles longer than the bridge cutoff are removed, leaving unsupported gaps open.
processing.notes: Surface fidelity varies with observed point support: dense regions render finer, sparse extents render coarser or open.

stats.notes: Counts, bounds, retained/dropped bridge triangles, edge-length distribution, and control points are observed in top_envelope_surface stats evidence.

render.colorRamp: top-point elevation colors using the Surface Elevation 1500-3500 m ramp, not resistivity colors
render.materialNotes: Flat-shaded observed mesh; material/depth behavior, opacity, spatial alignment, camera/page framing, and caveat visibility require visual review.
render.notes: Outer regions should become coarser where observed source point spacing widens; unsupported exterior gaps should remain open.

provenance.notes: Provenance says ready for demo preview but not final spatial analysis. This wrapper does not promote acceptance.

limitations: Top surface is the observed source-derived full-density MT model top envelope, not measured terrain.
Fidelity varies with observed point support; coarser outer triangles are expected where source spacing widens.
Unsupported exterior gaps are not filled; do not fabricate continuity from this surface.
Do not represent as public topo, lidar, DEM terrain, interpreted geology, wells, faults, seismic, target, resource estimate, or accepted surface interpretation.
Material/depth behavior, opacity, visibility, page role, and visual receipt require review.

questions: Does the UI-facing 3D MT top surface follow the visible full-density MT top-point cloud without a rectangular slab?
Do outer regions visibly coarsen where observed point spacing widens?
Are unsupported exterior gaps left open rather than filled?
What fixed cartographic datum/control points should be used for later non-digital verification?
What visual receipt proves material/depth behavior, opacity, spatial alignment, and camera/page role are acceptable?

notes: UI-facing top-surface wrapper records that the visible 3D MT top surface now uses the observed full-density top-envelope artifact. The older preview-derived cap and rectangular support-grid contact surface remain retained support/history data, not the current visible top-surface authority.
